# OpenAI Codex Changelog — captured 2026-06-02

## June 1, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.136.0
- Amazon Bedrock support for running Codex locally with AWS-managed authentication (Bedrock API key via AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK/AWS_REGION, or AWS SDK credential chain; SigV4 signing). (NEW since prior scan — underlying OpenAI-on-Bedrock GA since April 2026 / CLI v0.124.0)
- Session archiving via `/archive` command to protect threads from resume/fork. (NEW)
- Windows sandbox provisioning with elevated setup path. (NEW)
- Enhanced TUI markdown rendering with clickable web links and readable table formatting.

## May 28, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.135.0
- Enhanced `codex doctor` command with richer environment and thread diagnostics
- Vim mode text-object editing and configurable interrupt-turn binding
- Named permission profiles in `/permissions` slash command
- Bundled patched zsh helper for macOS and Linux
- Python SDK sandbox presets for thread and turn APIs

## May 29, 2026 — Version 26.527: Computer Use & Mobile Access on Windows
- Computer Use comes to Windows: the Codex app can see, click, and type in foreground Windows desktop apps (runs on the active desktop, takes over the foreground). Install the Computer Use plugin; invoke via @Computer or @AppName.
- Remote control extended to Windows devices via ChatGPT app on iOS/Android.
- Profile section added showing usage stats and token activity.
- Thread coordination improvements for local projects and worktrees.
- Limitations: cannot automate terminal apps or Codex itself; cannot authenticate as admin or approve OS security/privacy prompts.

## May 26, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.134.0
- Added search across local conversation history, including case-insensitive content matches with result previews
- Profile selection now prioritizes `--profile` flag across CLI, permissions, and sandbox workflows
- Enhanced MCP server setup with per-server environment targeting and OAuth capabilities
- Improved connector tool schema reliability through local reference preservation and schema compaction
- Read-only MCP tools can now execute concurrently when flagged appropriately
- Extended context for extension tools and subagent identification in hook inputs

## May 21, 2026 — Version 26.519: Appshots, Goal Mode, and Remote Computer Use
- Appshots (macOS): press both Command keys to send frontmost app window + screenshot to Codex.
- Goal Mode (GA): extended multi-hour objective tracking across app, IDE extension, CLI (0.128.0+).
- Remote Computer Use: access desktop apps after device lock; remote operation via Codex Mobile even when Mac screen is off/locked (time-bound auth, relock on first local input).
- Plugin Sharing: ChatGPT Business teams distribute reusable plugin bundles via marketplace sources.
- Browser improvements; Chrome extension refinements.

## Codex CLI 0.133.0
- Goals function by default with dedicated storage and progress tracking across turns
- `codex remote-control` operates as foreground command with improved readiness reporting
- Permission profiles expanded with list APIs, inheritance support, and Windows sandbox integration
- Plugin discovery enhanced with marketplace-aware output and remote collection support
- Extensions gain additional lifecycle event visibility including subagent transitions and tool execution

## May 20, 2026 — Codex CLI 0.132.0
- Python SDK authentication enhancements: API key login, ChatGPT browser flow, device-code flows.
- Text-based workflows accept plain strings.
